name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
source:
Satou Sasami is exhausted. She's thirty-six years old, and she works in a low-paying office job, lives in a rundown apartment, and doesn't have any love life to speak of.

Sasami's younger sister, Noriko, is set to be married soon, and in the lead-up to her sister's wedding, Sasami feels more inadequate than ever before. She needs something to change, and quickly...

So, she finds herself visiting her local shrine one night. Surely, if she prays hard enough, something good will happen in her life - like a cute girlfriend falling into her lap!

Sasami's desperate enough to try anything, but she doesn't believe in miracles. She worries she's doomed to be stuck in a tired, unfulfilling loop of work and sleep...

Until a cutie with a questionable fashion sense and a pair of fluffy fox ears comes into her life. Now what will Sasami do?!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636460/]Steam[/url]]
